items.title: Tapestry Shares Slide as Softer FY27 Revenue Outlook Overshadows Q4 Beat
Tapestry Stock Slides on Soft Outlook
items.summary: Shares in Tapestry fell 9% in premarket trading after the luxury-brand owner issued a soft outlook. The parent company of Coach and Kate Spade on Thursday said it swung back to profit in the fourth quarter.

items.title: Tapestry shares tumble despite earnings beat
items.summary: Investing.com -- Tapestry, Inc. (NYSE: TPR) reported fourth-quarter results that exceeded analyst expectations, but shares are down 8.9% premarket as the company's fiscal 2027 guidance disappointed investors.

items.title: Tapestry’s Coach Still Driving Sales as Company Gives Soft Outlook
items.summary: Tapestry said its Coach brand led sales growth for another quarter, while giving a soft outlook for its new fiscal year.

items.title: Tapestry (NYSE:TPR) Posts Q2 CY2026 Sales In Line With Estimates But Stock Drops On Weak Guidance
items.summary: Luxury fashion conglomerate Tapestry (NYSE:TPR) met Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q2 CY2026, with sales up 8.9% year on year to $1.88 billion. The company’s outlook for the full year was close to analysts’ estimates with revenue guided to $8.45 billion at the midpoint. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.32 per share was 3.4% above analysts’ consensus estimates.

items.title: Tapestry’s Annual Sales Hit $8B as Coach Continues to Drive Growth
items.summary: The company, which also owns Kate Spade, hit its three-year target in year one.
